description: Dependency Underuse & Replacement Advisor — Audits the dependencies of a public GitHub repo, commit or pull request (or uploaded manifests and sources) and returns a pass/warn/fail verdict, a 0-100 risk score, the top findings with manifest file:line and the fix, and a SARIF 2.1.0 log for GitHub code scanning. Parses JS/TS, Python and Rust imports with a tokenizer-level scanner and maps them to declared npm, PyPI and crates.io dependencies.

ecosystems.description: Restrict the analysis; default all detected.

files.description: Alternative to repo: manifests (package.json, lockfile, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, Cargo.toml) and source files with repository-relative paths.

mode.description: deterministic makes no model call; auto makes at most one, only for symbols the curated table cannot decide.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit; defaults to the default branch.

repo.description: Public GitHub repository: owner/repo, https://github.com/owner/repo[/tree/ref], a commit URL, or a pull request URL (analyzed at the PR head).

repoLicense.description: SPDX id of the repository's license, for alternative ranking; detected from manifests or LICENSE when absent.

name: dependency-advisor
